questions.q: In a SOQL query with GROUP BY, what rule applies to every field in the SELECT list?
options: It must be listed in ORDER BY
Only one field is allowed in the SELECT list
It must either be inside an aggregate function or appear in the GROUP BY clause
It must be a custom field
questions.explain: Every non-aggregated field in SELECT must also be grouped, the same rule as T-SQL.

questions.q: What does SELECT StageName, COUNT(Id) FROM Opportunity GROUP BY StageName return?
options: One row per distinct StageName with the count of opportunities in that stage
A single row with the total number of opportunities
Every opportunity record with a count column added
An error, because StageName cannot be grouped
questions.explain: GROUP BY collapses rows into one summary row per distinct value of the grouped field.

questions.q: What is the correct clause order in a SOQL aggregate query?
options: SELECT, WHERE, FROM, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT
SELECT, FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT
SELECT, FROM, GROUP BY, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT
FROM, SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, LIMIT, ORDER BY
questions.explain: WHERE filters individual rows before they are grouped, so it comes before GROUP BY, and ORDER BY and LIMIT come last.

questions.q: How do you sort the groups in a query by the number of records in each group, largest first?
options: ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
ORDER BY DESC COUNT
SORT BY COUNT DESC
GROUP BY COUNT(Id) DESC
questions.explain: Repeat the aggregate expression in ORDER BY and add DESC for largest first.

questions.q: What does GROUP BY ROLLUP(Type, BillingCountry) add to the results?
options: Only the rows with null values
A second copy of every row
Automatic sorting by Type
Subtotal and grand-total rows, in which the rolled-up field comes back null
questions.explain: ROLLUP adds subtotal and grand-total rows. The GROUPING() function tells a subtotal null from a genuine null.
